name: normalize_headers
representative_why: Users and imported templates often describe the same business field with different header text.
representative_how: rewrite only the declared header row cells
concrete_workflows: map budget category and amount columns before summarizing
standardize line-item invoice headers before append or formula extension
standardize attendance or inventory headers before summaries and reconciliation
verification_strategy: Supported scope verifies declared source headers exist, mapped output headers match, source workbook hash is preserved, and non-header rows/formulas are unchanged. Alias inference and duplicate resolution remain outside supported scope.
